name: Parsnip Lake House

evidence.note: Visitor review describes very limited seating, a standing bar in the middle of the room, and some people dancing to the band.
Review summary: live music, DJs, dancing and lake views; a reviewer says the DJ plays good dance music.
Summary says the small indoor space fills quickly while the outdoor deck is used for bands at sunset.

dancing.notes: The indoor room is small and fills up fast, but people do dance near the band. There is also an outdoor deck by the lake.

description: A small, casual neighborhood bar on Lake Ronkonkoma with a back deck over the water. It hosts bands, DJs and karaoke most nights.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Ira wrote 'Parsnips'; the business calls itself 'Parsnip Lake House' (older listings: 'Parsnip Pub'). The Voices Carry gig on Oct 3 was not found on the venue's site (its show list was empty). Facebook link comes from a Bing business listing.

Directory research 2026-10-04: The website is a barely edited Wix template (page title 'My Site 4', footer (c) 2023, empty show list, and its Instagram/X/YouTube icons point to Wix's own accounts), so it may not be kept up to date. The Facebook page is the one the site links; its URL uses the old numeric format. Instagram @parsniplakehouse was suggested by a search summary but could not be verified (Instagram needs a login), so not recorded. No hours on the site; third-party listings say roughly noon-2 AM daily, unverified. Flyers on the site show open mic night every Monday 7 PM (house band) and karaoke every Tuesday 7 PM. No logo or usable photos: the only images are text flyers, staff portraits and a tiny blurry video still. Site says free on-site parking is limited, with gas-station parking at night.

evidence.note: Bar's own site ('Meet Me at the Lake'): 432 Smithtown Blvd, Lake Ronkonkoma NY 11779, Parsniplakehouse@gmail.com, 631-285-2632; weekly open mic and karaoke flyers; free but limited parking on site; links the Facebook page.
Live music page shows 'No events at the moment' (checked Oct 4, 2026).
Third-party listing for Parsnip Lake House (older name Parsnip Pub) at the same address and phone, describing live music and a lake view.
